newsitem.title: USA: At least one dead as Boston bus plunges into river.
newsitem.headline: At least one dead as Boston bus plunges into river.

text.p: At least one man was killed when a passenger bus plunged into the icy Charles River late on Monday, police said.

The Massachusetts Bay Transportation Authority bus careened across the roadway near one of the bridges that connects Boston to Cambridge "and flew into the air and then went into the water," one witness told reporters.

The bus shattered a thin crust of ice and sank shortly after 10 p.m. (0300 GMT), MBTA police said. Only a small portion of the rear of the bus remained above water and served as perch from which teams of divers from the Cambridge, Boston and Massachusetts State Police searched for survivors.

After about 45 minutes of combing through the vehicle in the dark, cold waters, they found the bus driver. The driver, who was not immediately identified further, was rushed to Massachusetts General Hospital in Boston where he was pronounced dead at 11:20 p.m. (0420 GMT).
MBTA police said it appeared the driver was alone, but added further searches would be conducted.
Meanwhile hundreds of spectators gathered in the sub- freezing temperatures to watch the spectacle as police tried to figure out how to pluck the bus from the river.
